name: Nutanix - Range Auto Fill (one subnet per role: IPMI, hosts, CVM)
description: Range Auto Fill, as in Nutanix Foundation: Nutanix cluster with the BMC/IPMI addresses, the hypervisor hosts and the CVMs in separate subnets (for example management, servers, storage). Pick a subnet and an optional start IP for each role; an empty start IP takes the first free block.
